title: Golden Ears Field Safety Brief
description: A practical reader-first safety capsule for testing checklist content across reader, mobile, slides, and reel presentations.

sections.title: Bottom line
sections.body: Pack for damp, cool, variable weather and assume cell coverage may be unreliable. The core plan is simple meals, warm sleep, clean water, and a clear return time.

sections.title: Must-pack items
sections.body: Bring layered clothing, rain shell, headlamp, stove and fuel, water jug, bear-aware food storage, first-aid kit, paper map, battery bank, and dry socks.

sections.title: Arrival routine
sections.body: Set shelter before cooking, identify water and wash stations, store food away from the tent, and confirm the morning route before dark.

sections.title: Risk controls
sections.body: Avoid relying on a campfire for cooking, keep wet cotton out of the sleep system, and set a hard turn-back time for any side trip.

sections.title: Handoff note
sections.body: Share the itinerary, trailhead, campsite, vehicle plate, and return window with one person who is not on the trip.

cards.title: Field Safety
cards.body: One practical trip brief, packaged for reading, scanning, slides, and story review.

cards.title: Pack the basics
cards.body: Warm sleep, dry layers, light, water, food storage, and stove reliability matter more than gear novelty.

cards.title: Set camp first
cards.body: Shelter, water, food storage, and route confirmation should be done before dark.

cards.title: Control the risks
cards.body: Do not depend on fire, do not let wet clothes enter the sleep system, and keep a turn-back time.

cards.title: Tell someone
cards.body: The most useful safety feature is a clear external handoff before you leave.
